summary: 72mm diameter traction wheel with a molded rubber tread, an open spoked hub face and a central bore. The axis of rotation is along z.

mountingSurfaces.description: Flat hub face with a bolt-circle pattern of small holes, used to attach a hub or flywheel with screws
Opposite hub face, assumed to mirror the first for hub mounting

notes: Only the 72mm diameter is stated. The 24mm width and the 12mm central bore are visual estimates, not printed values, so verify them against the vendor drawing. The bolt-circle holes are visible, but their diameter and positions are not given, so they are left out. The drawings show the wheel mounted on an 8mm REX shaft through a hub and fastened with M4 screws, which suggests a hub-mounted pattern, but no dimensions are printed.
